# Three Goats' Tracks

*Last month three of Yarrek's goats strayed down a gully below the Long Ridge and came home wild. Follow their old tracks and hunt 40 Axe Stumps in what they ran from.*

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Town | [Midbarium](../towns/midbarium_quests.md) |
| Category | Story |
| Given by | [Yarrek](../npcs/yarrek_tolmach.md) |
| Level | 23 |
| After | [A Word for Tavi](../quests/sennu_word_for_tavi.md) |
| Leads to | [The Worst Stretch](../quests/tavi_the_worst_stretch.md), [The Wild Goats](../quests/yarrek_the_wild_goats.md) |

## Objectives

1. Look at the tracks at the gully floor in [The Long Ridge](../maps/long_ridge.md)
2. Look at the tracks among the trees in [The Long Ridge](../maps/long_ridge.md)
3. Look at where the tracks run in [The Long Ridge](../maps/long_ridge.md)
4. Defeat 40 [Axe Stump](../monsters/axe_stump.md) in [The Long Ridge](../maps/long_ridge.md)

## Rewards

- 5,450 EXP
- 460 mesos
- [Goat Cheese](../items/goat_cheese.md) x10
- [Highland Salve](../items/highland_salve.md) x5
- +40 standing with Midbarium
- +30 standing with [Yarrek](../npcs/yarrek_tolmach.md)
